==Flavor Text==

''Imagine the shame that would fall upon the poor soul in the stock covered with this monster.''

==About==

{{i|Big Red}}s are received rarely instead of Tomatoes when Picking {{i|Tomato}}es grown in {{i|Gardening Pot}}. A Big Red can be stored in a {{i|Veggie Sack}}. '''NOTE:''' A Big Red counts as a Tomato in recipes.
